text:
Predicates:
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Nautico(x) ::: x is the Nautico football club.
Braga(x) ::: x is the Braga football club.
Fluminense(x) ::: x is the Fluminense football club.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
CommonlyKnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Silva, 1995) ∧ CommonlyKnownAs(Silva, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
Footballer(Silva) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(Silva, Braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(Silva, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Nautico(Nautico) ∧ Braga(Braga) ::: Nautico and Braga are football clubs.
Brazilian(Silva) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Conclusion:
¬LoanedOutTo(Silva, y) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to any football club.
